description: Use raw source snapshots and shared immutable record batches while preserving logical canonical identities, hashes and history.
rationale: The project is in early testing; address measured storage growth now. A separate one-off conversion script is supplied for libhimmelblau, outside this repository change.
requirements: New source snapshots store exact raw bytes addressed by SHA-256 and survive cloning, cache deletion and Git text conversion.
New true-up imports batch canonical records and share bounded tree nodes for cumulative arrays and long strings instead of copying growing prefixes into each physical revision.
Reconstruct the exact logical JSON records, identities, hashes, evidence, revision chains and source bytes before applying existing validation and query rules.
Read legacy and mixed historical trees; preserve committed logical records and use the same metadata writer lock for import publication.
Verify container and value hashes, reject malformed references, source-path overrides, conflicting records and excessive expansion, and retain interrupted publication recovery.
Include tests and a repeatable synthetic size/round-trip benchmark. Do not add a migration command or migration framework to the PR.
title: Bounded shared storage for reconstructed canonical history
